title: Aurora Core
reference: repeat 6 { while not wall_ahead { forward if on_switch { activate } } if tile_is r { turn_left } else { turn_right } }
hints: Long corridors, switches along the way, and a signal pad at every corner. One loop can handle all of it.
Inside a while (no wall ahead): forward, and flip any switch you land on. At the corner, red turns left, blue turns right. Repeat.
repeat 6 { while not wall_ahead { forward if on_switch { activate } } if tile_is r { turn_left } else { turn_right } }

story.intro: VANTA: "The aurora core keeps this whole lab cold. Shut it down and you'll never catch me in the dark."
story.outro: PATCH: "Core's down, the lights are on, and VANTA just ran for the summit. One more climb, LoopBot."
